offer_cards.Heading: Learning step by step
offer_cards.Main: Learning foreign languages is like riding a bike: the more you actively practice, the better you get at it.

offer_cards.Heading: 24 hour full support
offer_cards.Main: LingLand supporters are online 24/7 for helping you everytime you want.

offer_cards.Heading: Speaking training
offer_cards.Main: Live Lessons with certified teachers improve speaking confidence and develop fluency. Choose Private Lessons or Live Group Lessons.

offer_cards.Heading: Learning anytime and anywhere
offer_cards.Main: LingLand allows you to learn a bunch of new words, no matter where you are: at the park, in the restaurant or home.

offer_cards.Heading: Travelling and testing your knowledge
offer_cards.Main: Expand you vocabulary for adventures abroad, as well as to prepare for international exams, such as IELTS, TOEFL etc.

offer_cards.Heading: Quick progress
offer_cards.Main: Customised AI-enabled revision tools that help each learner meet their daily goals and develop long-term practise habits.

comment_cards.Title: Perfect Solution in perfect time
comment_cards.Comment: I had a 100% satisfaction experience with lingland team. My problem was resolved in 48h as I said.

comment_cards.Title: This website is easy to ...
comment_cards.Comment: The website is easy to access and navigate.

comment_cards.Title: Best support
comment_cards.Comment: I write to LingLand often and always get a good response. My most recent experience was with Katya. She was super helpful and kind. She got extra help for me as my question was complicated. Then she followed up.

comment_cards.Title: Outstanding support
comment_cards.Comment: My problem was solved within one day. The support is responding to my questions very fast. Super!

comment_cards.Title: A new customer and so far very good
comment_cards.Comment: A new customer and so far, impressed with the course, and the speedy response to my technical questions.

comment_cards.Title: Way better than Duolingo
comment_cards.Comment: In the last three days, I have learned more Italian on LingLand than on Duolingo for months. The lessons (I can speak only for lower A1-A2 levels) are very well structured and there is plenty of vocabulary to explore.

comment_cards.Title: The best learning language app out there
comment_cards.Comment: I have tried out several Language Learning Apps over the years (like Duolingo, Babbel and so on). LingLand is definitely my favorite so far. Great pace to the learning progression without being too repetitive!
